scope: Swift call timing and recovery; actual current source includes earlier partial remaining_ms migration. This task fixes cache age/repeated sample renewal and lifecycle invalidation.

entrypoints.review: Reads one leased Core snapshot. Event selects only call ID; state, owner, duration and recovery eligibility come from that snapshot. Unknown or zero duration never sends a failure recovery report.

Subtracts snapshot age and monotonic elapsed time. Zero/unknown shows existing localized Checking text. Only an authoritative complete missing-call snapshot retires the view; no timer invokes cancelCall.
Invalidates timer revision and anchors while preserving the sample freshness barrier. prepareForCoreShutdown retains T20 camera/encoder behavior.

Retains the pre-suspension Core/sample identity and waits in Checking until a different sample or Core generation arrives. With no prior sample, first read only establishes the barrier baseline. Cached getters remain non-blocking.
Acquires a T20 expected-generation lease around the real C getter, JSON copy and free; refuses results after stop/generation change. Uses request-start monotonic uptime.
Optional expected generation is checked atomically in withCore; MainViewController always supplies it.
Core generation, snapshot generation, call/door/revision/owner/state form an anchor identity; repeated cache samples cannot extend an anchor.
Existing local return-to-home display timeout, not a comparison against Core expires_at_ms; unchanged.
No business call-expiry wall-clock comparison or CallTiming duration consumer in TVMainViewController. Shared CoreBridge and CallRevisionLifecycle compile in tvOS target.

Date fallback is used by unrelated notice/configuration timestamp paths; call countdown/recovery does not invoke this helper. Calendar formatting and idle/secret-tap Date uses remain outside T21 call authority.

authority_rule: Core alone terminates calls. Native timeout is a display observation, never a cancellation command.
availability: ProcessInfo.systemUptime, Foundation/CoreFoundation operations and existing IOSAvailability.scheduledTimer adapter; no new OS concurrency/time API or minimum OS increase.
preserved: T20 lifecycle withCore lease and expected-generation admission
Existing explicit user cancel and native unrecoverable in-call fail-closed report
